stdout: (no config - demo: a major feature with a pricing change for all customers, planned as a big launch)
AAJ - PRODUCT LAUNCH
TIER 2 - CUSTOMER LAUNCH
A major feature, but not a new product or market.
It changes pricing, which every affected customer has to hear from you first.
What it gets: Customers and the relevant segment hear about it properly - email, in-app, a post, a sales brief - without a market-wide campaign. The Must and Should tasks, and the go/no-go gates.
!  The team plans a market-wide launch for a Tier 2 change. Check that the market, not just customers, has a reason to care.
READINESS
54%  (13 of 24)  BUILDING PHASE - This is not a launch-planning problem yet. Setting a date now would move work you have not done into a week you do not have.
Positioning  3/4
Product      3/4
Audience     2/4
Assets       2/4
Team         2/4
Measurement  1/4
CLOSE THESE FIRST
[ ] Audience: You have named supporters lined up to amplify early.
Early momentum compounds; a flat first hour is hard to recover.
[ ] Team: The team knows the launch-day runbook and their role in it.
Launch day is execution, not planning. Rehearse the sequence.
[ ] Measurement: Tracking, UTMs and a dashboard are live.
You cannot optimise or report what you never instrumented.
[~] Positioning: You have a single, sticky launch hook you are confident in.
The hook does more for reach than any channel tactic.
[~] Product: The first-run experience is smooth for a brand-new user.
Launch traffic is mostly first-timers. Activation happens here or not at all.
[~] Assets: A launch landing page is built and QA'd.
The click has to land somewhere that converts, with working links and tracking.
[~] Assets: Core creative is ready: demo, screenshots, graphics, copy.
Making assets on launch day guarantees a rushed, weaker launch.
[~] Measurement: You have defined the launch goal and two to four target metrics.
Without a target you cannot tell a win from noise, or learn anything.
WORK-BACK PLAN  (39 days to launch)
T-30  2026-10-04  Must   Lock positioning and the one-line hook
T-30  2026-10-04  Must   Define the launch goal and 2-4 target metrics
T-30  2026-10-04  Must   Set the launch date and work-back timeline
T-28  2026-10-06  Must   Confirm the thing being launched is stable and demo-ready
T-28  2026-10-06  Must   Assign the launch owner and channel owners
T-25  2026-10-09  Should Build and clean the launch email list
T-24  2026-10-10  Should Draft the launch narrative and story angle
T-20  2026-10-14  Must   Build or refresh the launch landing page
T-18  2026-10-16  Should Record the product demo or launch video
T-16  2026-10-18  Must   Design launch graphics
T-15  2026-10-19  Must   Write launch-day copy for every channel
T-13  2026-10-21  Must   Build the launch email sequence: teaser, launch, recap
T-12  2026-10-22  Should Write the FAQ and objection handling
T-11  2026-10-23  Must   QA the landing page: links, tracking, forms, mobile
T-10  2026-10-24  Should Warm up the audience: teaser, waitlist, countdown
T-9   2026-10-25  Must   Line up supporters and early amplifiers
T-8   2026-10-26  Should Seed early users for testimonials and quotes
T-7   2026-10-27  Should Schedule social posts, founder and company
T-6   2026-10-28  Should Pre-write community and forum posts
T-5   2026-10-29  Must   Brief the team on launch-day roles and the runbook
T-4   2026-10-30  Must   Confirm tracking, UTMs and dashboards are live
T-2   2026-11-01  Must   Final QA and go/no-go dry run
T-0   2026-11-03  Must   Go live, post on the anchor channel early, email the list
T-0   2026-11-03  Must   Notify supporters and communities; be present all day
T-0   2026-11-03  Must   Monitor metrics, errors and sentiment
T+1   2026-11-04  Should Send the day-after recap and thank supporters publicly
T+3   2026-11-06  Should Retarget visitors who did not convert
T+4   2026-11-07  Should Repurpose the launch into content
T+5   2026-11-08  Should Collect and publish testimonials
T+7   2026-11-10  Must   Run the retro: metrics against goals
T+10  2026-11-13  Should Capture learnings and update the playbook
T+14  2026-11-17  Must   Nurture new signups into activation
T+21  2026-11-24  Should Report results to the team and investors
GO / NO-GO ON THE DAY
[ ] Product: The feature is live, stable, and the core flow works end to end
[ ] Tracking: Analytics, UTMs and conversion events are firing
[ ] Landing: The landing page loads and all links and CTAs work on desktop and mobile
[ ] Team: Owners are online and know the runbook
FINDINGS
-  A date is set while readiness is in the Building phase. Most launches that slip were dated before the gate was clear.
